summary: Obsidian Energy filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian continuous-disclosure report) furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results news release, MD&A, interim financial statements and CEO/CFO certifications. No transaction, offer or structural event is announced. Q3 production averaged 28,113 boe/d, funds flow $86.7M and net income $18.0M; the company repurchased 0.9M shares for $13.0M at an average $15.08 under its normal-course buyback. The recent Belly River acquisition is performing above plan. Net debt was $363.3M. This is a routine earnings filing; no deal terms apply.
